about: Regulator watch sources. Each RSS feed is fetched, filtered and de-duplicated into vault/regwatch.json. include_link / exclude_title are case-insensitive regexes: tune them here, not in code. 'manual' lists regulators that publish no feed; the digest links them for a human check.

feeds.title: RBI press releases

feeds.title: SEBI circulars, regulations and press releases
